source_clause: HVACP10.1) If Climate is located in the main category bar, fan speed and mode popups display from this position as well during idle mode.
reasoning: 驗證目標：14.10.1（HVACP10.1）定出 Climate 位於主類別列時，風速與模式 popup 於 idle 期間亦自該位置顯示，單一 leaf。關鍵情境條件：同 14.1.1；條文之前件「If Climate is located in the main category bar」為版面配置，**其變異範圍未定義**，故不寫入配置式 PC 而以步驟之觀察對象承載（§8.4.1）。為什麼這樣切：一句一 leaf。刻意略過：條文列 fan speed 與 mode 兩種 popup，本條以 fan popup 為代表（同 14.3 之理由）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: HVAC popup 本身（其顯示、內容與逾時）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: **不補** —— 6.3 之移除對象為 head unit 之 comfort section，而其明文例外正是 `except for comfort popups`；本節之可觀察量即 popup，故下螢幕車上仍在（**本批首次以證據放下該排除**）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 **ch14 側全無列**（ch16 十八節無 popup 專章），故全批皆為 `no-counterpart` 而 verdict `yes`

tcs.tc_title: Fan and mode pop-ups display from the category bar in idle mode
tcs.test_item:
HVACP10.1) If Climate is located in the main category bar, fan speed and mode popups display from this position as well during idle mode.

(change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control and read where the pop-up appears -> The fan pop-up appears from the position of Climate in the main category bar)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Put the head unit into simulated off/idle mode
2. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control and read where the pop-up appears
tcs.expected_result:
1. The head unit is in simulated off/idle mode
2. The fan pop-up appears from the position of Climate in the main category bar
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無任何 HVAC popup 之專章（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch14 側全無列）—— 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，故 EMEA ICS 車輛上本條無對象，排除成立

tcs.test_item_authored: If Climate is located in the main category bar, fan speed and mode popups shall display from this position as well during idle mode
